aggregate_examples.eligibility: A paired second leg with known first-leg score, same leader before and after, and a result opposite to the aggregate winner.
aggregate_examples.interpretation: The before and after aggregate margins are from the second-leg home club's perspective; positive means that club led the tie.
aggregate_examples.measure: Second legs whose result carried less than full information because the losing club remained ahead on aggregate.
aggregate_examples.order: Lowest information weight first, then newest date.
aggregate_examples.title: Controlled second-leg cases

peaks.eligibility: At least 50 prior retained results and post-match uncertainty no greater than 145 points.
peaks.interpretation: The record is the estimated strength. Its historical reference changes with the strongest association; cross-era absolute strength is not established.
peaks.measure: The highest cautious published rating a club held immediately after a retained match.
peaks.order: Descending post-match rating; ties break by the earlier date.
peaks.title: Post-match club peaks

strongest_matches.eligibility: Both pre-match uncertainties must be no greater than 145 points.
strongest_matches.interpretation: This describes the strength of the pairing, not the importance or entertainment value of the match.
strongest_matches.measure: The sum of both clubs' cautious ratings before kick-off.
strongest_matches.title: Highest-rated matches

upsets.eligibility: A decisive win, at least half ordinary evidence weight, and both uncertainties at or below 145 points.
upsets.interpretation: Draws and penalty shootouts are excluded. Identity and duplicate checks run before this list is built.
upsets.measure: Negative log probability of the winning outcome: −ln(P(observed winner)).
upsets.order: Descending surprise; a smaller pre-match win probability produces a larger score.
upsets.title: Largest winning upsets

year_opening_number_ones.eligibility: Active within 550 days, tier one, at least 50 prior results, uncertainty at or below 145 points.
year_opening_number_ones.interpretation: Years before the evidence network clears those safeguards are not labeled with a corpus leader.
year_opening_number_ones.measure: The highest eligible rating at the opening of each calendar year.
year_opening_number_ones.title: Eligible corpus leaders at year opening
